$comment: WWN spell effects, batch 1: the thirteen High Magic level-1 spells. Source: the Worlds Without Number SRD (CC0, data/sources/game_system_rights.json), spells.md. Each row is a *structured paraphrase* of the mechanical content — range, duration, target counts, save category and any formula — not the SRD's prose. Rows the GM must still adjudicate carry "manual": true and say why in "note". Spells not listed here are untranscribed: the resolver refuses them rather than guessing.

ignores: non-magical intervening barriers, if the caster can see the target unaided
effects.note: NPCs with a single hit die die regardless of the damage rolled.

effects.targets: one creature or one visible weapon
effects.duration: creature: one round per two caster levels, rounded up; weapon: the rest of the Turn
effects.note: The creature form calls for a save on every weapon hit; the weapon form has no save. Once per Turn per target, natural weapons excluded, and the caster cannot be the creature target.

effects.targets: one visible normal, non-magical animal or insect
effects.duration: until released, dispelled, or cast again
effects.note: The beast obeys non-suicidal commands and shares its senses while the caster spends a Main Action focusing; it will not fight. What counts as suicidal or out of character is the table's call.

effects.targets: an area of 10-ft cubes equal to the caster's level
effects.range: visible point within 100 ft per caster level
effects.duration: until dispelled, dropped, or cast again

save.on_success: rejects the illusion for that creature
save.timing: each round, once the creature believes it false

effects.note: Phantasmal attackers use the caster's hit bonus, deal 1d8, have AC 10 and vanish if struck; at most one per two caster levels. Creatures dropped to zero hit points fall unconscious and wake after ten minutes with 1 hit point.

effects.targets: up to one contiguous 10-ft cube per caster level of non-magical plant matter, or plant-based monsters
effects.note: Ordinary plant matter is destroyed outright; enchanted plant matter is unaffected.
Surface thoughts come free; one memory question per caster level is asked at the risk of the spell ending. Casting is subtle — no visible gesture or audible word.

effects.duration: until dispelled, or the caster dies or releases the subject
effects.note: Commands must be physical and non-suicidal; no questions, judgment calls or non-physical abilities. Recasting gives every prior subject an unmodified save, and a subject with more hit dice than the caster saves daily against strongly objectionable orders.

effects.duration: failure: the rest of the Turn; success: the next round only
effects.note: One sense is controlled: false impressions, or blinding and deafening. Blinded creatures cannot make ranged attacks and roll melee twice, taking the worse. Tactile distraction costs a Physical save to act each round; a creature that believes itself in mortal peril may save at the end of each round.

effects.targets: up to one willing creature per caster level
effects.range: 100 ft at casting; targets may separate afterwards
effects.duration: up to one hour per caster level
effects.note: Missile attacks against invisible foes are largely impossible and melee attacks suffer -4. Any violent motion (running, attacking, casting) breaks it, and breaking it for one subject breaks it for all.

Reveals active magic as auras, identifies items with a one-sentence description, shows mages who have spells prepared, and grants normal sight in perfect darkness. Subtler readings need Wis/Magic checks at difficulty 8 or more.

effects.targets: up to one willing creature per caster level

cost.applies_to: each creature that uses the movement

effects.note: Cast as a Free action. Doubles ground movement, allows running on walls and ceilings, avoids parting attacks without a Fighting Withdrawal, and lets the subject slip past armed foes who do not fully block the way.

effects.targets: one willing or helpless creature the caster touches
effects.duration: up to one day per caster level
effects.note: A Free spell, only if nothing else was cast this round. The subject is immune to all non-magical harm and weighs four items of Encumbrance. The caster may end it early unless the subject is the caster, in which case the full duration must elapse.

effects.targets: all living creatures within a 20-ft radius
effects.duration: until roused, or the end of the Turn
effects.note: Creatures with 4 or fewer hit dice fall unconscious instantly; damage or a Main Action rouses them, and unroused targets wake at the end of the Turn. Creatures that do not sleep are immune.
